issues.title: Dangling Subfolder References
issues.why: The overview lists 16 subfolders (e.g., 07-csharp, 09-powershell) that are not provided in the context, preventing the AI from knowing the specific rules for those languages.
issues.fix: Provide the 00-overview.md and 97-acceptance-criteria.md for all referenced language subfolders.

issues.title: Missing Concrete Code Examples for Code-Red Rules
issues.why: While rules like 'Zero Nesting' (R3) are stated, the parent module lacks inline 'Before/After' code snippets for all 5 languages, forcing the AI to guess idiomatic guard clauses.
issues.fix: Add a 'Worked Examples' section to 00-overview.md showing R1-R6 implementations in Go, TS, and Rust.

issues.title: Vague 'Language-Specific Exceptions' for Size Limits
issues.why: AC-CG-08 allows exceptions for size limits but delegates the definition to subfolders which are missing from context.
issues.fix: Explicitly list the allowed exception patterns (like Go table-tests or Rust match arms) in the parent AC-CG-22 ledger.
